description: RequirementProfile 与 hardware_catalog 的消费契约（静态说明）。实现以 Pydantic RequirementProfile 为准，本文件随目录结构演进。
principles: 第一层只产出 RequirementProfile，不查询 hardware_catalog。
PartsSelectionAgent 以 RequirementProfile 与 hardware_catalog 为数据源；映射文件说明字段与路径约定。
profile 中不出现具体 SKU；SKU 仅存在于 hardware_catalog/data/*.json 的 items[]。
selection_context.must_satisfy 进入 PartsSelectionAgent 前必须只包含可执行结构化约束。
语义标签必须先通过 selection_constraint_mapping.json 编译，不能作为硬过滤字符串直接进入第二层。
预算、策略、提示类信号不得作为单品硬过滤条件；由 budget_context、compatibility_checks、cross_module_signals 或最终校验处理。
cross_module_signals 不直接过滤商品；只有被 selection_constraint_mapping.json 映射为结构化约束后才影响选择。

selection_context_contract.must_satisfy: Only executable constraint objects are allowed after compilation. Unknown hard semantic tags are moved out of hard filtering.
selection_context_contract.prefer_satisfy: May contain executable preference constraint objects and non-blocking semantic preference tags.
selection_context_contract.avoid: Executable avoid objects are preferred; textual avoid tags are non-blocking scoring hints unless explicitly mapped.
selection_context_contract.cross_module_signals: Carried for explanation and debugging. Signals must be mapped by selection_constraint_mapping.json before they become executable constraints.
